001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.salvage.special;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.InteractionDialogAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.PersonAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Commodities;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.AddRemoveCommodity;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.salvage.SalvageSpecialInteraction.SalvageSpecialData;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.salvage.SalvageSpecialInteraction.SalvageSpecialPlugin;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
013
014public class SleeperPodsSpecial extends BaseSalvageSpecial {
015
016        public static final String OPEN = "open";
017        public static final String NOT_NOW = "not_now";
018        
019        public static enum SleeperSpecialType {
020                CREW,
021                MARINES,
022                OFFICER,
023                ADMIN,
024                ORGANS,
025        }
026//      public static enum SleeperSpecialQuantity {
027//              LOW,
028//              MEDIUM,
029//              HIGH,
030//      }
031        
032        public static class SleeperPodsSpecialData implements SalvageSpecialData {
033                public SleeperSpecialType type;
034                //public SleeperSpecialQuantity quantity;
035                public int min, max;
036                public PersonAPI officer;
037                public SleeperPodsSpecialData(SleeperSpecialType type, PersonAPI officer) {
038                        this.type = type;
039                        this.officer = officer;
040                        min = max = 1;
041                }
042                public SleeperPodsSpecialData(SleeperSpecialType type, int min, int max) {
043                        this.type = type;
044                        this.min = min;
045                        this.max = max;
046                }
047                
048                public SalvageSpecialPlugin createSpecialPlugin() {
049                        return new SleeperPodsSpecial();
050                }
051        }
052        
053        private SleeperPodsSpecialData data;
054        
055        private int quantity = 1;
056        
057        public SleeperPodsSpecial() {
058        }
059
060        @Override
061        public void init(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Object specialData) {
062                super.init(dialog, specialData);
063
064                data = (SleeperPodsSpecialData) specialData;
065                
066//              if (data.quantity != null) {
067//                      switch (data.quantity) {
068//                      case LOW:
069//                              quantity = random.nextInt(10) + 5;
070//                              break;
071//                      case MEDIUM:
072//                              quantity = random.nextInt(20) + 10;
073//                              break;
074//                      case HIGH:
075//                              quantity = random.nextInt(50) + 25;
076//                              break;
077//                      }
078//              }
079                quantity = data.min + random.nextInt(data.max - data.min + 1);
080                
081                if (data.type == SleeperSpecialType.ORGANS) {
082                        //quantity *= 0.5f;
083                        if (quantity < 1) quantity = 1;
084                }
085                
086                SleeperSpecialType type = data.type;
087                
088                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
089                        if (type == SleeperSpecialType.CREW || type == SleeperSpecialType.MARINES) {
090                                quantity = Math.round(quantity * Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_sleeperPodsSpecialCrewFraction"));
091                                if (quantity < 1f) quantity = 1;
092                        } else if (type == SleeperSpecialType.ORGANS) {
093                                quantity = Math.round(quantity * Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_commoditySalvageDropFraction"));
094                                if (quantity < 1f) quantity = 1;
095                        }
096                }
097                
098                CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
099                
100                int crewBerths = (int) (player.getCargo().getMaxPersonnel() - player.getCargo().getTotalPersonnel());
101//              int officerBerths = (int) (Global.getSector().getPlayerPerson().getStats().getOfficerNumber().getModifiedValue() - 
102//                              player.getFleetData().getOfficersCopy().size());
103                if (crewBerths < 0) crewBerths = 0;
104//              if (officerBerths < 0) officerBerths = 0;
105                
106                
107                if (type == SleeperSpecialType.CREW) quantity = Math.min(crewBerths, quantity);
108                if (type == SleeperSpecialType.MARINES) quantity = Math.min(crewBerths, quantity);
109                //if (type == SleeperSpecialType.OFFICER) quantity = Math.min(officerBerths, quantity);
110                if (type == SleeperSpecialType.ADMIN || type == SleeperSpecialType.OFFICER) quantity = 1;
111                
112                switch (type) {
113                case CREW:
114                        initCrew();
115                        break;
116                case MARINES:
117                        initMarines();
118                        break;
119                case OFFICER:
120                        initOfficer();
121                        break;
122                case ADMIN:
123                        initOfficer();
124                        break;
125                case ORGANS:
126                        initOrgans();
127                        break;
128                }
129        }
130
131        
132        protected void initCrew() {
133                if (quantity <= 0) { 
134                        initNothing();
135                } else {
136                        addText("While making a preliminary assessment, your salvage crews " +
137                                        "find some occupied sleeper pods still running on backup power.");
138                        
139                        options.clearOptions();
140                        options.addOption("Attempt to open the pods", OPEN);
141                        options.addOption("Not now", NOT_NOW);
142                }                       
143        }
144        
145        protected void initMarines() {
146                if (quantity <= 0) { 
147                        initNothing();
148                } else {
149                        addText("While making a preliminary assessment, your salvage crews " +
150                        "find some occupied mil-grade sleeper pods still running on backup power.");
151                        
152                        options.clearOptions();
153                        options.addOption("Attempt to open the pods", OPEN);
154                        options.addOption("Not now", NOT_NOW);
155                }                       
156        }
157        
158        protected void initOfficer() {
159                if (quantity <= 0) { 
160                        initNothing();
161                } else {
162                        addText("While making a preliminary assessment, your salvage crews " +
163                                        "find a single occupied sleeper pod still running on backup power.");
164                        
165                        options.clearOptions();
166                        options.addOption("Attempt to open the pod", OPEN);
167                        options.addOption("Not now", NOT_NOW);
168                }                       
169                
170        }
171        
172        protected void initOrgans() {
173                if (quantity <= 0) { 
174                        initNothing();
175                } else {
176                        addText("While making a preliminary assessment, your salvage crews " +
177                                        "find some occupied sleeper pods still running on backup power.");
178        
179                        options.clearOptions();
180                        options.addOption("Attempt to open the pods", OPEN);
181                        options.addOption("Not now", NOT_NOW);
182                }                       
183                
184        }
185        
186        
187        @Override
188        public void optionSelected(String optionText, Object optionData) {
189                if (OPEN.equals(optionData)) {
190                        
191                        switch (data.type) {
192                        case CREW:
193                                addText("One by one, the pods begin to open as the thawing process completes. " +
194                                                "Most of the occupants come through alive, if somewhat dazed.");
195                                
196                                playerFleet.getCargo().addCommodity(Commodities.CREW, quantity);
197                                AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityGainText(Commodities.CREW, quantity, text);
198                                
199                                break;
200                        case MARINES:
201                                addText("One by one, the pods begin to open as the thawing process completes. " +
202                                "Most of the occupants come through alive, if somewhat dazed.");
203                                
204                                playerFleet.getCargo().addCommodity(Commodities.MARINES, quantity);
205                                AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityGainText(Commodities.MARINES, quantity, text);
206                                
207                                break;
208                        case OFFICER:
209                                addText("The thawing process completes, and the pod opens. " +
210                                                "It contains an experienced officer, who joins you out of gratitude for being rescued.");
211
212                                playerFleet.getFleetData().addOfficer(data.officer);
213                                AddRemoveCommodity.addOfficerGainText(data.officer, text);
214                                if (data != null && data.officer != null && 
215                                                data.officer.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.EXCEPTIONAL_SLEEPER_POD_OFFICER) &&
216                                                !data.officer.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.EXCEPTIONAL_SLEEPER_POD_OFFICER_MADE_ON_SECTOR_GEN)) {
217                                        CryopodOfficerGen.incrNumExceptionalCreated();
218                                }
219                                break;
220                        case ADMIN:
221                                addText("The thawing process completes, and the pod opens. " +
222                                        "It contains an experienced planetary administrator, who joins you out of gratitude for being rescued.");
223
224                                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAdmin(data.officer);
225                                AddRemoveCommodity.addAdminGainText(data.officer, text);
226                                break;
227                        case ORGANS:
228                                addText("One by one, the pods begin to open as the thawing process completes. " +
229                                                "Unfortunately, it's been too long, or something went wrong along the way, and there are no survivors - at least, not with any brain activity.");
230                
231                                playerFleet.getCargo().addCommodity(Commodities.ORGANS, quantity);
232                                AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityGainText(Commodities.ORGANS, quantity, text);
233                                break;
234                        }
235                        
236                        
237                        setDone(true);
238                        setShowAgain(false);    
239                } else if (NOT_NOW.equals(optionData)) {
240                        setDone(true);
241                        setEndWithContinue(false);
242                        setShowAgain(true);
243                }
244        }
245
246        
247        
248}
